page.layout: One printed page, all lines centred: title block at the top (UBBONIS EMMII; RESPUBLICÆ; ·GRÆCORUM.; Pars Secunda.), a woodcut of a tree with a banner, then the imprint (LUGD. BATAV.; Ex Officinâ ELZEVIRIANA,; ANNO date; Cum Privilegio.). No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The woodcut between "Pars Secunda." and the imprint shows a tree in leaf with a scroll-shaped banner across its lower left reading "NON SOLUS", a standing figure in a long robe reaching toward the branches on the right, and a ground line of grass below. The banner text is included above as a printed line. The left edge carries cut-off fragments of the neighbouring page and was left out. The date is copied from cIↄ Iↄ c xxxii, read as M, D, C, XXXII. The "u" in the printed title words was read as a vowel per the rules (UBBONIS, RESPUBLICÆ, GRÆCORUM, LUGD.).
